name: NotificationBell

requiredCapabilities: native button props, accessible label, pointer/focus and click callbacks
AISEE inner glyph motion and badge state driven by real count; outer button stays fixed

preserve: Keep the inline bell icon, hover/focus, numeric badge and optional unread dot.
Real count increases ring the white bell and animate the badge number. Rerenders, unchanged/decreased/cleared counts must not replay incoming animation.
The outer button and black icon circle remain fixed; respect prefers-reduced-motion. Connect count and onClick to existing product data and navigation.
Preserve AISEE visual layout, scoped styles, states, icons, animation timing, interactions and accessibility when adapting host primitives; host default styling must not replace them.
